purpose: Exercise production geometry on simultaneous curved OSM-derived XY and non-flat Z/grade changes while preserving a strict distinction from source-backed engineering elevations.

vertical_datum_assumption.definition: At each station anchor, z_test_m = -published_depth_m. A single flat zero surface is assumed only to synthesize vertical relief.
vertical_datum_assumption.warning: z_test_m is not UGR, not an absolute elevation, and not a reconstruction of the actual Moscow surface or track profile.

station_depth_anchors.selection_rule: 53 m chosen deliberately for the geometry-stress preset; 48 m retained as unresolved alternate

construction.vertical_curve_model: parabolic vertical curve implemented as linear grade transition

krasnopresnenskaya_to_kievskaya.source_backed_directional_constraint: S140: immediately after Krasnopresnenskaya, 38‰ downhill in Track-B direction; later rises toward Kievskaya
krasnopresnenskaya_to_kievskaya.disclaimer: Only 38‰ magnitude/direction and qualitative later rise are source-backed. All transition lengths, low-point chainage/Z and rise grade are geometry-test choices.

runtime_contract.use_xy_from: S138 dated OSM physical Track-B snapshot

runtime_sampling.method: 25 m chainage resample plus forced vertical-control, station, switch and mainline-way-boundary chainages
runtime_sampling.reason: Original OSM route geometry has only 57 vertices; vertical extrema/curves must not disappear between sparse XY vertices.
